rationale: No existing spec exercises the RUM Session Replay feature. traceDetails.spec.js opens generic trace details but never asserts the gated Play Session Replay button; the RUM dataflow specs prove _rumdata/_sessionreplay ingestion through the real SDK but never open a trace-detail Play button nor the no-replay empty state. This feature is a single cohesive area (RUM Session Replay) whose dominant UI entry point is the Traces TraceDetails view, so a dedicated spec in Traces/ (per run-context spec_path) is the right home. The no-replay empty state is a RUM-surface assertion that belongs to this same feature (reachable only through session replay), so it lives in this spec rather than a separate RUM shard; see the plan's Notes for the area nuance.
